## Samsung Faces ITC Patent Probe Over HBM and DDR5 Memory Products

An ITC probe on HBM is a material supply chain risk — if Samsung were forced to modify or restrict HBM shipments, it would create acute scarcity for hyperscaler customers and could benefit SK Hynix and Micron. The complainant identity, when disclosed, will clarify whether this is a competitor-driven action or an IP licensor play — that distinction determines the severity of the supply disruption risk.

- The U.S. International Trade Commission has opened a patent probe targeting Samsung's HBM and DDR5 memory products.
- The probe introduces legal and supply risk to Samsung's highest-value AI memory revenue lines at the moment of peak cycle earnings.
- No complainant identity, specific patents, or investigation timeline is named in the headlines.
- High classifier confidence given the direct intersection with Samsung's most critical AI-cycle product lines.
